title: 5.4 Equilateral and Isosceles Triangles

icans: I can use the Base Angles Theorem to find angle measures.
I can use the converse to find side lengths.
I can use the properties of equilateral triangles.

vocab: the two angles __________ to the base

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Base Angles Theorem: if two sides of a triangle are congruent, then the angles _______________ them are congruent.

blocks.stem: An isosceles triangle has a vertex angle of 40°. Find each base angle.

notes: Converse of the Base Angles Theorem: if two angles of a triangle are congruent, then the sides opposite them are _______________.
titles: Converse of the Base Angles Theorem

blocks.stem: Two angles of a triangle measure 50°, and the sides opposite them measure (3x − 2) and (x + 10). Find x and the length of each side.

notes: Corollaries: a triangle is equilateral if and only if it is _______________, so each angle of an equilateral triangle measures 60°.

blocks.stem: An equilateral triangle has sides of (4x − 3) and (2x + 9). Find x, the side length, and each angle.
An equilateral triangle has sides of (5x − 8) and (3x + 4). Find x and the side length.
